description: This file contains the definition of the Subscription class within the Opencart admin extension report namespace. It provides methods to retrieve subscription data and counts for reporting purposes, integrating with the database to execute SQL queries based on filter criteria.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Represents the report extension model for subscriptions, providing data retrieval methods for subscription reports.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Fetches a list of subscription records from the database based on filter criteria such as status, date range, and grouping.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns the total count of subscriptions based on filter criteria for summary reporting.
